name: oasis-support-knowledge
prerequisites: Actual product/source/UI/public facts, supported locales, topic source map and an available explicitly selected knowledge destination for live registration.

scenarios.trigger: Current consumer confirms a renamed UI action
scenarios.expected: Update paired facts and source mapping with actual labels.

scenarios.trigger: Old locale key exists but no UI uses it
scenarios.expected: Do not present it as a current action.

scenarios.trigger: Local checks pass but live model has not been queried
scenarios.expected: Report live answer evaluation NOT RUN.
